# uptimekuma_notification_serwersms (Resource)

SerwerSMS notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_serwersms" "example" {
  name         = "SerwerSMS Notification"
  username     = "your_serwersms_username"
  password     = "your_serwersms_password"
  phone_number = "+48501234567"
  sender_name  = "YourCompany"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: password_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change password_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_serwersms" "write_only" {
  name = "SerwerSMS with a write-only secret"

  username     = "your_serwersms_username"
  phone_number = "+48501234567"
  sender_name  = "YourCompany"

  password_wo         = "your_serwersms_password"
  password_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `phone_number` (String) Recipient phone number
- `username` (String, Sensitive) SerwerSMS account username

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SerwerSMS account password. Stored in state; use `password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SerwerSMS API password, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `password`; requires `password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `password` until the next apply with `password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `password_wo`.
- `sender_name` (String) Sender name or identifier

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
